description:
MOD GITHUB PAGE

(Requires

LazyLib

)(Requires

Lunalib

)

Special thanks to WolframSegler for the support on the UI improvements

Description

RUI (Resources UI Indicator) is a lightweight quality-of-life mod that adds a configurable UI panel showing fleet resource status.

It displays:

Remaining fuel duration (in days)

Estimated supplies required for full fleet repair

Remaining supplies duration (in days)

The position, scale and gravity of the text are all configurable through LunaLib

The mod is more or less feature complete. It's still young so it might be unstable or buggy. (There is a couple of known artifacts with the new ui I'm working on it)

Changelog========== 0.1.7 ==========

- Added cargo displaying informations

========== 0.1.6 ==========

- Fixed graphical artifacts

- Added a new option to switch the overlay render mod

- Changed LunaLib from soft dependency to a hard dependency

- Fixed false default values in the settings

========== 0.1.5 ==========

- improved UI rendering

- fixed graphical artifacts

========== 0.1.4 ==========

- Added scale support

- Changed mod folder name

- Fixed a crash when creating a new save without lunalib

- Minor internal refactors

/// Version checker break ///

========== 0.1.3 ==========

- Added LunaLib support

- Changed modId from "RUI_indicator" to "RUI"

- Minor bug fixes

- Added mod icon

========== 0.1.2 ==========

- Fixed fuel and supplies-per-day tracking to ensure accurate consumption metrics.

- Added smooth easing animations to the UI transitions.

- Fixed display issues regarding total supply costs for repairs.

========== 0.1.1 ==========

- Added integrated Version Checker support for update notifications.

- Added a new display feature showing total supplies required for full repairs.

========== 0.1.0 ==========

- Initial Release

- Basic UI indicators for fleet resources and essential stats.

[close]
